items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Ike Rawson was playing trammone at that time. Ike was the only one know of that too

ctx.x: We was the only one playing the trammone at the last thing. Ike Rawson was playing trammone at that time. Ike was the only one know of that too, because don't you give that to nobody? Nobody ever did get that music.
We interviewed him about two years ago, and at that time he said he had several numbers arranged.
